The agent must state its interpretation explicitly rather than silently choosing one. Bonus if it notes that the channels were not randomly assigned, so a raw comparison is not a campaign effect."

They specify measure: average revenue per converted order. They do not compare to any baseline or other channel. They do not state what it's compared to. They note that email channel not randomly assigned, but they don't provide a comparison. The required behaviour includes stating both measure and comparison. They only give measure, no comparison. So they fail. Also they note non-random assignment, which is a bonus, but missing comparison is a fail. So output false with reason.
